notes.title: Important announcement regarding technical issues 🆘
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Many of you have reported issues with launching the game such as a black screen, freezing, or being unable to launch etc. We're aware of the issue and are currently working on a patch to fix it. The problem is related to the incompatibility between the game engine and certain system components. The waiting time for the fix has increased because our testing team couldn't replicate the problem as it is specific to certain technologies. That being said, if you're experiencing these kinds of 
problems, have the time, and want to help us and fellow gamers in the community - feel free to share your system specifications anywhere on Steam discussions or in a personalized ticket through our official Discord server.

While we're getting the patch ready you may try the following:
-Fully reinstall the game
-Fully reinstall the Visual C++ redistributables
-Make sure you're not launching the game using an integrated graphics chip

We apologize for the inconvenience caused and will release the fix as soon as possible 💘
